description: Realistic athlete questions with the library sources a good answer needs: the calibration set, which chooses the relevance floor and every other threshold. No athlete data. follow_up questions carry the athlete's earlier questions (newest first) in `previous`: Coach searches a follow-up with the topic of the last real question. A question with `region` is asked by an athlete in that region; the others by one outside India. Questions without a kind need one topic's sources; multi_source questions need sources from two or three topics; no_answer questions are near the library but outside it (medication, rehabilitation, specific diseases, sport technique, pregnancy, minors, medical diets, eating disorders, medical reports, drugs) and have no expected sources: a good answer says so. `style: colloquial` marks gym slang, typos and Indian-English phrasing. The first 92 questions were written against the first 49 sources; the rest were written blind from each later source's title and topic, never from its chunk text. library_questions_holdout.json holds the hold-out set. E4 added 17 questions asked from the UK, the US and Australia (and two from athletes with no region) for the eight regional and body-measure sources; they were written from each source's title and topic before any retrieval was run.
